messages:
deploybot: canary swap complete for engine-v2.14-quant on slice=canary-us-east-1 at 1748601234. POST-SWAP METRICS: p50=45ms p95=170ms p99=420ms (baseline p99=110ms). Note: spike started ~2m after swap.

liam: saw the p99 jump. traces show long-tail sitting in matmul_q8 kernel hot path. only on A100-80 instances.

tia: any difference in quant flags? engine-v2.14 turned on `q8_sparse_opt` by default for quantized matmul. could be falling back to scalar path for certain sequence lengths.

arjun: rolling back the canary slice to engine-v2.13 (no q8_sparse) seems safest. we should not unroll the whole night window yet.

liam: agreed. do targeted rollback for canary and hold the rest. command?

arjun: `deploybot rollback --slice canary-us-east-1 --from engine-v2.14 --to engine-v2.13 --reason "canary p99 thermal/regression"`

deploybot: rollout action accepted. rolling back slice canary-us-east-1 -> engine-v2.13. expected completion ~3m. Will emit post-rollback smoke.

opsbot: alert routed to oncall and perf-watch channel. tagging perf-oncall:nina. :bell:

nina: i'm on it. pulling flamegraphs now. can you run a quick metrics query?

liam: query I ran: ```promql: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le))``` shows tail spike correlated with increased GPU memcpy stalls.

tia: memcpy stalls could be because the sparse kernel uses a different workspace layout that triggers unaligned DMA on older driver build. context: some A100 nodes still on driver 510.x while others are on 515.x.

arjun: ops: which hosts are on older driver? can we list?

opsbot: driver-report: gpu-us-east-1-a-12 (510.73), gpu-us-east-1-a-15 (515.48), gpu-us-east-1-a-18 (510.73). Failing samples: a-12 and a-18.

nina: that explains it. q8_sparse path expects memcpy alignment fixed in 515 driver. for safety we need either: 1) skip enabling q8_sparse by default until we gate driver version, or 2) teach kernel to fallback earlier to non-sparse path deterministically.

liam: immediate remediation: 1) confirm canary rollback completed, 2) mark engine-v2.14 as "blocked-by-driver" in release notes, 3) create ENG ticket for kernel fallback and driver gating.

arjun: rollback done. deploybot: `rollback-complete` smoke: p99 back to ~115ms.

deploybot: action summary: canary rollback completed at 1748601282. post-rollback smoke ok.

tia: i'll open a hotfix branch to strip q8_sparse default flag and build engine-v2.14-p0. also cc CI to run deterministic builds against matrix of driver versions.

nina: assigned ENG-5432 -> owners tia, liam. notes: reproduce on v510 driver, add test harness in CI to catch memcpy stalls, add explicit guard in runtime for driver<515 to disable q8_sparse.

liam: i'll add release note fragment: "Canary rollout paused: engine-v2.14 had p99 regressions on some A100 hosts due to q8_sparse kernel triggering memcpy stalls on older drivers. Canary rolled back; engine-v2.14 blocked pending driver gating or kernel fallback fix."

arjun: ops pin suggestion: pin us-east-1 region to engine-v2.13 for 6h while we validate hotfix? or only pin canary slice?

opsbot: suggestion: pin region would be broader than needed; recommended approach: keep global rollout paused and do region pin for us-east-1 for 6h: `deploybot pin --region us-east-1 --bundle engine-v2.13 --ttl 6h --reason "driver mismatch causing q8_sparse regressions"`.

arjun: go ahead and apply pin.

opsbot: pin request executed: us-east-1 -> engine-v2.13 TTL 6h. Routing and autoscaler notified.

tia: CI will build v2.14-p0 without q8_sparse and run preflight across driver matrix. ETA 1h. will post results here.

nina: perf-watch keeping eyes on other regions. will alert if we see similar tail behavior after re-enable. :eyes:

liam: thanks team. filing handoff note for morning crew. will mark thread as active until hotfix preflight passes.
